current_bottleneck: Frozen-proposal reweighting is directionally useful but not sufficient: it nearly fixes overall/per-cell coverage and improves level KS from 10/25 to 12/25 while preserving most 392a path geometry, but it weakens conditionality and one cointegration cell and remains far below the level KS gate.
last_result_summary: 483a trained and evaluated at results/block_ar/483a_frozen_proposal_density_ratio_s42/full11.json. It reached 6/11, passing surface, time-series, block-AR, cross-cell correlation, mean reversion, and pathwise realism, while failing coverage, conditionality, cointegration, regime coverage, and distributional fidelity. Coverage almost passed with only h30 best-cell overcoverage at 96.9%; conditionality MAE reduction fell to 3.47%; worst-cell cointegration ratio fell to 0.175; level KS improved to 12/25 but stayed below the 15/25 gate.
next_step_recommendation: Do not promote 483a; 392a remains the 8/11 deployable frontier. Choose a controlled post-experiment decision next: either run one principled reweighting-strength ablation to test whether the density-ratio signal can improve 392a without losing conditionality/cointegration, or close the frozen-proposal branch if the criterion is plausible 11/11 upside rather than incremental coverage movement.
